message.content: Lachlan finds Cersei's end particularly haunting, especially given how much she fought to hold onto her power. It felt like it all caught up to her in the end, which was portrayed in a tragically poetic manner. Lachlan expresses a desire to see more of Cersei confronting her past decisions, wondering whether she would have made different choices if her children were alive. This suggests that Lachlan sees Cersei's ultimate downfall as a reflection of her relentless pursuit of power, despite the cost to her relationships and sense of fulfillment.
